note.text: First Device resource in this project — the implant placed at UC02b-I3 (2026-07-15). Manufacturer, catalog/model number, and lot number are synthetic placeholders per the source appendix ('to be filled with actual manufacturer'). Placement torque (35 Ncm) is carried as a structured Device.property (UCUM N.cm) as well as in the note, since it is a named test value and Device has no dedicated torque element. NOTE on modeling: FHIR R4 Device has no bodySite element — the implant's tooth #30 site lives on the linked Procedure (procedure-implant-tooth30) via Procedure.focalDevice, not here. No us-core-implantable-device profile is asserted: this synthetic record has no UDI and a text-only type, so claiming that profile's conformance would be unverifiable. Transmitted to the general dental practice in the I4 post-operative summary (via CarePlan.supportingInfo and Task.output) so Dr. Parker's practice can select the correct abutment and crown components at the restorative phase without a records request.
